main_text.p: nera & cædes pro ludo ac joco habeant & sanguinis effusione oculos pascant & oblectent. Exemplo sunt, congressus illi Arngr. singulares, in Islandiâ etiam- Jonæ in descript. num usitati, in quibus victus Island, censetur, qui cruore primum humum tinxerit. Et illi in Angliâ, sub regibus (an lege probati, an potius per conniventiam, quod mihi fit probabile) non ita pridem, cum ibidem degerem instituti, in quibus gladiatores cæsim depugnabat in Theatro, & pugnam continuabant, donec alteruter sanguinem emisisset, vel læsus fuisset. Exemplo etiam fuere tot veterum commissiones, bestiarum cum mancipiis, & mancipiorum inter se. page.notes: Marginal notes on the right: "Arngr.", "Jonæ in descript.", "Island," (printed as one note group "Arngr. Jonæ in descript. Island," beside lines 1 to 3 of the paragraph). Running head "De Duellu" last letter uncertain. Printed "pro ludo" and "Islandiâ" transcribed as printed; "Islandiâ" and "Angliâ" carry the printed circumflex. The black dot in the right margin beside "fuere" is a mark, not text, and is omitted. Catchword "cro-" is partly cut off at the foot of the page.
